title: Uniform approximation of continuous compactly supported forms by test forms
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let U, V ⊆ ℝ^P with V open and V ⊆ U. Let ω : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) n be continuous with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ V, and let ε > 0. Then there is η ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport η ⊆ V and |ω(x) − η(x)| ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Eucl P)) (ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n), IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → tsupport ω ⊆ V → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ V ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ ε
